name: date-management-workers
description: Cloudflare Workers production deployment for Date Management API

scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env development
scripts.test:build-artifact: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const routes=['/api/expired-items/reports/expired-losses','/api/subscription/current','/api/organization/usage'];const artifact=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.js','utf8');for(const route of routes){if(!artifact.includes(route)){throw new Error('Built Worker artifact is missing '+route)}}"
scripts.test:preview: npm run test:build-artifact && cross-env RUN_WORKERS_PREVIEW_TESTS=true vitest run src/workers-deployment.test.ts
